x: To begin with Arthur's training companion was that famous old Surrey AC character and Olympic Gold Medallist Joe Deakin. With regular outings over four or five miles a foundation of fitness was gradually laid - but not without considerable discomfort.
Arthur's initial outings were in the company of Joe Deakin (gold medallist 3 miles team race 1908 Olympics!) and Joe's young grandson Joe Cleverly, both members of Surrey A.C.
